Bhoja^3 Mārtikāvata (the Bhº from Mṛttikāvatī, a descendant of Mahābhoja). § 593 (Abhimanyuvadhap.): VII, 48, 1892.
Bhojā (the queen of Yuyudhāna). § 589 (Droṇabhishekap.): VII, 10, 338 (Y. had conquered her by defeating the army of the Sauvīra king).

Bhojarāja^5 = Kṛtavarman(?). § 793 (Mausalap.): XVI, 7, 245 (Hārdikyatanayaṃ Pārtho nagaraṃ Mārttikāvataṃ | Bhojarājakalatrañ ca hṛtaśeshaṃ narottamaḥ).
